# netbox_available_prefix (Data Source)

Retrieves a single available prefix from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_available_prefix" "example" {
  prefix_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `prefix_id` (Number) The ID of the prefix associated with the available prefix.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `prefixes_available` (List of Object) The prefixes available of the available prefix. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefixes_available))

<a id="nestedatt--prefixes_available"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefixes_available`

Read-Only:

- `family` (Number)
- `prefix` (String)
- `vrf_id` (Number)
